title: DataManifest
description: Per-file provenance + integrity manifest for files under data/. Keyed by POSIX-relative path. Consumed by validate-data skill (Section 1 Provenance) and by emit-repro-log to populate ReproLog dataset_checksums field.

$generator.description: Identifier of the script that wrote this manifest, e.g. tools/build_data_manifest.py@<version>

$generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of last full rebuild

$git_head.description: Project git HEAD at generation time

sha256.description: Full 64-hex SHA-256 of the file's bytes

retrieval_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC when this entry's SHA was first computed (preserved across rebuilds unless content changes)

retriever_script.description: Project-relative POSIX path to the script that pulled this file; 'manual' if not retrieved by an automated script

retriever_git_head.description: Git HEAD of retriever_script at retrieval time

source_uri.description: Canonical source URL/URI for this file (user-supplied; preserved across rebuilds). Required for files in data/external/ and data/raw/; optional elsewhere.

license.description: SPDX identifier (e.g., CC-BY-4.0) or free-text license note. User-supplied; preserved across rebuilds.

snapshot_date.description: ISO calendar date of the data snapshot (vendor-side date, not retrieval date). User-supplied; preserved across rebuilds.

notes.description: Free-text user notes; preserved across rebuilds.
